method.knowledgeBase: A single narrow lookup for BuildingDefinition/DefenseFacility/PowerGrid/IndustrialFacility returned no rows; the current source and authored YAML assets were used as authority.
method.assetCountMethod: Counted YAML .asset references to each declaring MonoScript GUID. Counts are evidence of current authored reachability, not an execution result.
method.result: Four confirmed modular-extension blockers; no unresolved candidate findings. One deliberate save compatibility boundary is recorded as a non-finding.

findings.problem: The public runtime-factory extension contract works only when a caller manually constructs a catalog or uses the non-injected three-argument dispatcher constructor. A separately DI-registered IBuildingAbilityRuntimeFactory never reaches the production dispatcher.

productionEvidence.evidence: IBuildingAbilityRuntimeFactory is the executable binding contract; the exact-type catalog rejects a runtime definition without a factory; CreateBuiltIns explicitly accepts additionalFactories.
The sole VContainer.Inject constructor accepts only work and fallback handler lists and always creates the catalog with CreateBuiltIns() without factories.
Production registers handler collections and the dispatcher but has no composition path that feeds registered runtime factories to that dispatcher.
Real building initialization calls the injected dispatcher to bind BuildingSO.Abilities, so the omitted factory collection is production-reachable.

findings.smallestReproducer: Register a custom executable BuildingAbility definition, its IBuildingAbilityRuntimeFactory, and its work handler in the production container; resolve IBuildingAbilityRuntimeDispatcher and initialize a BuildingSO containing the definition. Binding throws 'No runtime factory is registered' even though the factory was registered.

existingTargetedNativeEntries.coverage: Proves a custom factory binds only when manually passed to CreateBuiltIns and that missing/duplicate/invalid factories reject.
Uses the non-production three-argument dispatcher with a custom handler and factory, then proves real work output and state-module persistence.

findings.smallestRepairBoundary: Inject the IBuildingAbilityRuntimeFactory collection into production dispatcher composition and pass it to CreateBuiltIns, preserving duplicate and executable-capability validation.

findings.problem: The climate catalog discovers definitions generically and persists their IDs, but rejects every valid sixth zone or seventh weather front through a hard-coded content census.

productionEvidence.evidence: The constructor reads all zone/front assets, builds ID dictionaries, then requires exactly five zones and six fronts.
All later lookup, runtime use, and save restore are generic and ID-based. The seasonal 100-weight validation is an invariant independent of the content count.

findings.smallestReproducer: Add and catalog a sixth valid ClimateZoneDefinitionSO or seventh valid WeatherFrontDefinitionSO. Constructing ResourceClimateDefinitionCatalog throws before ClimateRuntime can start.

existingTargetedNativeEntries.coverage: Current authoring entry for the five-zone/six-front set.
Uses the production climate catalog in an executable environment path.

findings.smallestRepairBoundary: Remove only the exact 5/6 census; retain validity, duplicate-ID, and seasonal weight-total checks.

findings.problem: Token definition assets author sourceMetric, threshold, and decayPolicy, but production event recording does not receive the definition provider and mints only hard-coded token IDs under hard-coded conditions. New token content using an existing metric cannot execute without a new content-ID branch.

productionEvidence.evidence: The asset declares sourceMetric, threshold, decayPolicy, consumePolicy, recipeTags, and uiHint. Runtime consumption looks up only EffectiveId and consumePolicy; producer semantics are not projected.
The production recorder constructor has no token-definition provider.
Visit, revenue, stock, crime, defense, and clean-day producers directly reference FacilityEvolutionTerms token constants and embed thresholds/conditions.
Definition assets are cataloged and queryable by ID, confirming they are registered but their producer fields are ignored.

authoredRowsVsProducer.producer: Mints once when daily visits reach the caller-provided minimum and incidents equal zero; it does not evaluate ServiceQuality or 0.7.
No production AddToken call exists; only downstream readers and editor/manual fixtures reference this token.
Mints on DefenseAttackConcept.Guard; it does not evaluate ZoneSafetyScore or 0.4.
Mints event amount for any food stock consumption at a meal facility; it updates StockCostPerVisit but does not compare the authored threshold.
Mints every caller-provided visit step; no TurnoverRate metric or 0.65 comparison drives it.
Mints when a defense report has TotalDamage greater than zero, independent of the authored threshold.
Mints for each combat visitor at a meal facility; it updates CombatVisitorRatio but does not compare 0.25.
Mints per noble visit and per revenue event above a caller-provided value; it does not compare NobleVisitorRatio to 0.25.
Mints for every crime event while also incrementing NegativeMentionCount; the authored threshold and decay policy are not evaluated.

findings.smallestReproducer: Catalog a tenth token definition whose sourceMetric names an already-recorded metric and whose threshold is satisfied; emit that existing visit/revenue/stock event. The record's new token count remains zero.

existingTargetedNativeEntries.coverage: Resolves the production recorder and verifies the hard-coded CleanServiceStreak and HighMeatConsumption tokens.
Audits current token definitions and consume policy but does not prove definition-driven production.

findings.smallestRepairBoundary: Introduce the smallest explicit producer binding that makes supported existing event semantics executable while preserving all current token thresholds and balance. The nine authored sourceMetric/threshold/decay rows do not map one-to-one onto the recorder's current increments, so unsupported rows must remain fail-closed rather than receiving an inferred generic fallback.

findings.problem: Climate forecasting and durable observation-equipment ownership are selected by one numeric BuildingSO ID even though the authored tower already opts in through existing workstation and semantic-tag capabilities.

productionEvidence.evidence: Both equipment maintenance and forecast availability query only building:8851.
The lifecycle describes a weather-observation capability but closes active slots unless BuildingData.id equals 8851.

The current tower already has BuildingSemanticTagsAbility tags research:climate:weather-observation and workstation:v19:weather-observation plus a BuildingProductionWorkstationAbility with the same workstation tag.
An existing production pattern explicitly excludes numeric IDs and filters operational facilities by an authored workstation capability.

findings.smallestReproducer: Author a second operational BuildingSO with the existing workstation:v19:weather-observation capability and valid observation equipment, but a different ID. It never enables forecast, is never maintained by ClimateRuntime, and its active climate equipment slot is closed as capability-removed.

existingTargetedNativeEntries.coverage: Exercises slot assignment and lost-owner reconciliation but currently resolves only the authored 8851 tower. It is the narrow place to add a second capability-equivalent definition witness.

findings.smallestRepairBoundary: Centralize weather-observation eligibility on the existing authored capability/tag and use it consistently for runtime selection and durable-slot reconciliation.

nonFindings.disposition: Restore deliberately rejects saved unknown modules and newly required current modules. Adding a stateful ability to an existing BuildingSO therefore needs an explicit save migration. The repository has a targeted rejection test and the assigned scope identifies state interfaces as intentional, so this is recorded as a migration boundary rather than a defect.

A new capability/effect/evolution module that introduces genuinely new mechanics may require an enum, handler, factory, or module registration. The audit reports only ignored registrations or existing-capability content that cannot execute.

reviewed.name: BuildingLightingSettingsSO
reviewed.compositionAndPersistence: Referenced optionally by BuildingLightingAbility inside BuildingSO's SerializeReference ability collection; values are immutable definition data and runtime light configuration is derived on binding. Missing settings use declared constants.
reviewed.reason: A new settings asset can be referenced by any lighting ability without a content-ID branch. Zero current standalone assets is valid because the reference is optional.

reviewed.name: BuildingSO
reviewed.compositionAndPersistence: BuildingSO owns a polymorphic BuildingAbilityCollection (`BuildingAbilityContracts.cs:38-92,129-180`) and BuildableObject binds runtime abilities, state modules, visuals, and world registration. State capture/restore is module-ID based (`BuildingStateModule.cs:123-262`). Industrial, environmental, production, and facility behaviors are composed as abilities rather than selected by building ID.
reviewed.reason: The data composition and state boundary are open, but production DI drops additional runtime factories and the climate service selects an already-authored weather-observation capability by one building ID.

reviewed.name: ClimateZoneDefinitionSO
reviewed.compositionAndPersistence: Projected to immutable ClimateZoneDefinition and resolved by canonical ID during climate runtime and restore.
reviewed.reason: The generic catalog is followed by an exact-five guard.

reviewed.name: DebugProbeDefenseEffectSO
reviewed.compositionAndPersistence: Editor-only derived effect inserted into a cloned BuildingSO defense effect array and executed through the real DefenseFacilityResolver.
reviewed.reason: The fixture is direct evidence that a new derived defense effect executes without a central effect-type switch.

reviewed.name: DefenseBurnEffectSO
reviewed.compositionAndPersistence: DefenseFacilityData stores DefenseEffectSO references; virtual Apply emits burn status and environmental ignition commands. Assets are immutable definitions and mutable status lives in the status runtime.
reviewed.reason: Additional burn assets use the same executable command path without an ID branch.

reviewed.name: DefenseChargeEffectSO
reviewed.compositionAndPersistence: Virtual Apply emits status and threshold/discharge damage through IDefenseEffectCommands.
reviewed.reason: New charge content is parameterized by asset fields and follows the shared effect transaction.

reviewed.name: DefenseCorrosionEffectSO
reviewed.compositionAndPersistence: Virtual Apply emits corrosion status; the mutable status runtime owns duration/stacks and combat projection.
reviewed.reason: Additional corrosion assets execute without content-specific registration.

reviewed.name: DefenseDamageEffectSO
reviewed.compositionAndPersistence: Virtual Apply sends damage through the transactional command boundary; each failed effect rolls back body, status, report, and receipts.
reviewed.reason: Damage variants are data-only asset additions.

reviewed.name: DefenseEffectSO
reviewed.compositionAndPersistence: Abstract strategy with immutable authored amount/duration/stacks/log tag and virtual Apply(IDefenseEffectCommands).
reviewed.reason: Runtime dispatch is polymorphic and the open-strategy fixture proves a previously unlisted effect reaches production execution.

reviewed.name: DefenseGuardAttackEffectSO
reviewed.compositionAndPersistence: Virtual Apply emits guard-attributed damage through the shared command boundary.
reviewed.reason: Additional guard-attack assets need no content-ID branch.

reviewed.name: DefenseSlowEffectSO
reviewed.compositionAndPersistence: Virtual Apply emits slow status and movement delay; runtime state is owned outside the SO.
reviewed.reason: Additional slow assets use the shared effect/status path.

reviewed.name: FacilityBlueprintSO
reviewed.compositionAndPersistence: Owns a SerializeReference BlueprintUnlockCollection. Completion iterates BlueprintUnlock and calls virtual Apply; save/restore resolves blueprint IDs and freezes unlock result records.
reviewed.reason: The targeted DebugBlueprintUnlock fixture executes an unlisted unlock subclass and formats its result without a core branch.

reviewed.name: FacilityCrimeSettingsSO
reviewed.compositionAndPersistence: A required singleton immutable rules asset injected through IFacilityCrimeSettingsProvider; mutable crime state remains in facility/runtime owners.
reviewed.reason: This SO is a global policy authority rather than an extensible content family; all fields have production consumers and no peer mutation was found.

reviewed.name: FacilityEvolutionRecipeSO
reviewed.compositionAndPersistence: Cataloged generically; source matching uses building references or lineage tags, requirements are arrays, and effective recipe IDs drive visibility, proposals, formula authority, and persisted evolution state.
reviewed.reason: A new recipe using registered existing formula capabilities is discovered without recipe-ID branches. New evolution mechanics requiring a module registration are outside the defect criterion.

reviewed.name: FacilityEvolutionRecordTokenDefinitionSO
reviewed.compositionAndPersistence: Definitions are cataloged by EffectiveId and consulted during token consumption, while token counts/metrics are mutable facility record state.
reviewed.reason: The producer ignores the definition's source metric, threshold, and decay fields and hard-codes every mintable token.

reviewed.name: FacilitySynthesisRecipeSO
reviewed.compositionAndPersistence: Cataloged generically; building references define materials/result, recipe/research IDs govern visibility and operation identity, and world save restores resulting building state through the normal building persistence path.
reviewed.reason: New recipes built from existing synthesis semantics are discovered by the catalog and execute without recipe-ID switches.

reviewed.name: RoomEnvironmentSettingsSO
reviewed.compositionAndPersistence: A required singleton immutable formula/mood/presentation policy asset injected through IRoomEnvironmentSettingsProvider; room runtime owns changing environment state.
reviewed.reason: All policy projections are consumed; role colors fall back through FacilityRoleCatalog rather than requiring per-content branches.

reviewed.name: WasteProcessingRulesSO
reviewed.compositionAndPersistence: Required singleton rules asset validates then projects immutable WasteProcessingRulesDefinition; mutable batches, processing state, and save DTOs are held by economy runtimes.
reviewed.reason: Existing origin/disposition records and recipe/feed/legacy mappings are data-driven. Exact enum-origin coverage is a completeness invariant; adding a genuinely new origin mechanic requires enum/rule authoring and is not itself a modularity defect.

reviewed.name: WeatherFrontDefinitionSO
reviewed.compositionAndPersistence: Projected to immutable WeatherFrontDefinition, ordered/weighted generically, selected by season, and restored by canonical ID.
reviewed.reason: The generic catalog is followed by an exact-six guard.

crossBoundaryObservations.observation: ResourceGameContentCatalog.GetAll<T> exact ItemDefinitionSO handling and ResourceItemDefinitionSO/Generic subtype queries are outside this owner audit and were not duplicated here.

Facility evolution formula module registration and economy catalog/effect families were inspected only far enough to prove the assigned recipe and building consumers; their standalone SO inventories belong to other owners.
